_meta.title: Organophosphates
_meta.source_doc: Bara ICU Dosing Card 2024 / HJH ED 2026

drug.adult_dose: Atropine: 0.04-0.05mg/kg IV (3-5mg adult), double every 5min until atropinised | Infusion: 200mg Atropine in 200ml 0.9% NaCl (1mg/ml), 10-20% of total dose/hr
drug.notes: Decontamination is key. Endpoint is clearing of pulmonary secretions, NOT tachycardia or pupil size.
